topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I turned the key in the old lock, the metal cold beneath my fingers, and pushed open the attic door. The air up here held a distinct scent of time past, a mix of dust and preserved memories. I stepped in, my flashlight cutting through the dim, and there they were—boxes and trunks, silent witnesses to the lives of the previous residents. I crouched beside a wooden trunk, its surface carved with initials and dates. Lifting the lid, I found layers of clothes, a boy’s scout uniform, and a stack of yellowed letters tied with a frayed ribbon. Each item whispered stories of the past, connecting me to the lives once lived within these walls. I ran my hand over the uniform, marveling at the small hands that must have worn it, and closed the trunk gently, a custodian of these quiet relics.
